title: Ways a game is drawn
origin: map-v1 (FND.SPECIAL: draws; the id FND.DRAWS is ours because the foundation ids split SPECIAL into castle/en passant/promote only)

D0.outcome: Lists the ways a game can end drawn (stalemate, agreement, repetition, fifty-move rule, insufficient material) and says which of them the player can claim and which are automatic.

D1.outcome: Given a short sequence on the board, says when a position has occurred for the third time and what must be true (same side to move, same rights) for it to count.

D2.outcome: In mixed endings, classifies each as won, drawn by insufficient material, or still playable, including positions that look drawn but are not (king, bishop and knight against a king, which is a win).

D3.outcome: Plans a game ending: counts the fifty-move clock in a rook ending, says what resets it, and decides whether to avoid or seek a repetition.

misconceptions: A position repeated three times is always a draw, whoever is to move.
King and two knights against a bare king is a draw by the rules (it is not automatic; mate cannot be forced).
The fifty-move count restarts on every check.
sources: sources/sheets/capablanca_chess-fundamentals.md §5 items 11, 14 (two knights; wording of the fifty-move rule)
conditions: Repetition needs the same position with the same side to move and the same castling and en passant rights.
The fifty-move count resets on a capture or a pawn move, not on a check.
Insufficient-material draws apply only when no sequence of legal moves could produce mate (bare kings, king and one minor piece against a king).
condition_sources: rules; Cap §5 item 14 notes the book's wording is not the modern rule
contrasts: King and two knights against a bare king cannot be forced to mate (tablebase-verified draw) yet the game is not drawn automatically by the rules; the book's claim that a defender's pawn changes this is unverified.
Three occurrences with the other side to move do not count as the same position.
A pawn exchange 40 moves in resets the clock, so counting from the start of the game is meaningless.

soft_prereq_notes.END.MATE-STALEMATE-AVOID.D1: stalemate and repetition appear together in drawn endings
